name: astermade
description: Aster Studio site. Static HTML/CSS/JS with Vercel serverless functions (api/enquiry.js, api/admin/enquiries.js) for contact enquiries and the staff console.
comment: There is deliberately no build script. The pages are flat static files served as-is; this manifest exists only so Vercel installs the two dependencies below. Adding a build step here would change how the whole site deploys.
